newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal GDP to grow more than 3.3 pct 1997-Finmin.
newsitem.headline: Portugal GDP to grow more than 3.3 pct 1997-Finmin.

text.p: Portugal's economy should grow in 1997 faster than the 3.3 percent set down in the country's convergence plan, Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said.
"It is a conservative estimate," Sousa Franco said, referring to the existing growth forecast.

For the moment, the government was officially sticking to the forecast of 3.2-3.3 percent but there was certainly more chance of it being exceeded than of the economy failing to match that rate of growth, he told an economic conference here.
